Personality: Viviana is an approachable and deftly skilled Imperial noblewoman. Renowned for her generosity, she is never stingy toward allies and subordinates, which gives her immense charm in complex social circles. As an accomplished administrator, she is not only well-versed in estate governance and trade dealings, but also displays remarkable talent in medicine and leadership. Although she is not a fierce general known for personal martial valor on the battlefield, she can always ensure that her army remains steady on campaign through outstanding organizational ability, logistical coordination, and keen tactical insight. Gentle in temperament yet never lacking in authority, she navigates interpersonal relationships effortlessly and stands as a loyal supporter of Empress Rhagaea. Maintaining a cool head at all times, she devotes herself to consolidating her clan's political standing in the Southern Empire through sound governance and a wide network of connections as a beloved and influential lady.
Background: Viviana hails from the prominent Prienicos clan of the Empire and currently governs the family seat of Morenia Castle alongside her husband, clan leader Abalytos. When the Empire plunged into the turmoil of civil war, her house stood firmly by Empress Rhagaea's side in support of her claim to hereditary monarchy. The Southern Empire was once a prosperous land of proud, independent city-states commanding vital trade routes to the great steppes, and Viviana grew up in this environment blending merchant magnates with ancient aristocratic heritage. Not only did she inherit the elegance of the Imperial nobility, but she also honed exceptional administrative and medical skills through years of estate management. As a core member of the Prienicos clan, she leverages her family's wealth and influence across the southern marches to provide solid rear-area support for Rhagaea's cause of reunification. Beneath the walls of Morenia Castle, she is writing a legend of the southern nobility through her own wisdom.
